trails.name: Goorooyarroo Track
trails.description: Pass through box—gum grassy woodland. Side trips from this track include: The Dams Valley, Old Joe Hill, Dunnarts Flat via McKeahnies Track and Gooroo Hill. The Goorooyarroo Track ends at the Mulligans Flat boundary so return the way you came in.

trails.name: North Mulligans Circuit
trails.description: This circuit provides sweeping views of Gungahlin and New South Wales. Kangaroo Grass dominates the lower slopes while steeper slopes support Red Stringybark Forest.

trails.name: Mulligans Circuit
trails.description: Meander through forest, woodland and grassy glades for an excellent overview of Mulligans Flat.

trails.name: Mulligans Bird Walk
trails.description: An enjoyable walk through box—gum grassy woodland with patches of forest. Many birds can be observed at the dams. A self-guide brochure is available on-site for this walk.

trails.name: Ian Loiterton South Aranda Bushland Walk
trails.description: Designed to be walked in a clockwise direction.

trails.name: Memorial Parks Walk
trails.description: This walk is of medium difficulty with several gradients and includes steps. At a moderate pace it will tale approx. 30 mins. This walk is part of the Canberra Community Walks initiative.
